glosses.notes: Can refer to archaeology as a field or to the activity of studying objects and sites from earlier times.

examples.sentence: 老师谈到考古的时候，没有把它说成离我们很远的事，而是让大家看那些从地下出来的东西怎么说明过去的人是怎么生活的。
这个城市准备修路以前，先请专业人员来看一看，因为一旦在地下发现重要材料，后面的考古工作就不能太着急。
她后来第一次去做考古的时候，才知道大家不是看看就行，而是要在地上一点一点找，还要把看到的情况都记下来。

example_translations.translation: When the teacher talked about archaeology, he did not describe it as something far away from our lives. Instead, he showed everyone how those things brought up from underground explain how people in the past lived.

Before this city starts road construction, it first invites specialists to take a look, because once important materials are discovered underground, the archaeology work that follows cannot be rushed too much.

The first time she later went to do archaeological work, she realized that people could not just look around and be done. They had to search bit by bit on the ground and also write down all the situations they saw.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to formal assessment of work, study, or performance against a set standard.

examples.sentence: 公司这次考核不只看最后的数字，也看你平时怎么和别人合作、出了问题以后是不是愿意自己先想办法解决。
新来的老师先把考核标准写得很清楚，所以大家虽然压力不小，心里却知道应该把时间放在哪些地方。
如果只拿一次失误去决定整个考核结果，那对很多一直认真做事的人来说，其实并不公平。

example_translations.translation: This round of assessment at the company does not only look at the final numbers. It also looks at how you usually cooperate with others and whether, after problems appear, you are willing to think of solutions yourself first.
The new teacher first wrote the assessment criteria very clearly, so although everyone felt a lot of pressure, they still knew where they should place their time and effort.
If one single mistake is used to decide the result of the entire assessment, then for many people who have been working seriously all along, that is actually unfair.

glosses.notes: Often used for a difficult situation that shows whether a person or plan can really hold up.

examples.sentence: 真正的考验不是事情最顺的时候，而是计划突然变了以后，你还能不能冷静地把该做的事一件一件做好。
那段一个人照顾家里又要上班的日子，对她来说是很大的考验，不过也让她看见自己比想象中更能坚持。
大家本来都觉得这个任务不难，后来天气、时间和人手一起出问题，才知道这次考验比原来想得复杂得多。

example_translations.translation: The real test is not when things are going most smoothly, but whether after the plan suddenly changes, you can still calmly finish the things that must be done one by one.
That period when she had to take care of the family and also go to work by herself was a major trial for her, but it also let her see that she could persist even more than she had imagined.

Everyone originally thought this task would not be difficult. Later, when the weather, time, and staffing all ran into trouble together, they realized that this test was far more complicated than they had first expected.

glosses.notes: Refers to a subject area, academic field, or department such as a hospital department or school subject.

examples.sentence: 他原来只觉得这一科有点难，后来听了那位老师讲的内容，才发现自己一直都很喜欢，只是以前没有机会认真学。
医院里每一科的工作都不一样，所以病人挂号以前最好先把自己的情况说清楚，免得来回跑很多次。
孩子问我大学里为什么要分那么多科，我就告诉他，因为世界太大，一个人不可能一下把所有问题都学完。

example_translations.translation: He had originally only felt that this subject was a little difficult, but after hearing that teacher speak, he discovered that he had actually liked it all along and simply had not had the chance to study it seriously before.
The work of each department in the hospital is different, so before registering, patients should explain their situation clearly first to avoid having to run back and forth many times.
The child asked me why universities divide things into so many fields, and I told him that because the world is too large, one person cannot possibly learn every problem all at once.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to stories, films, or novels that imagine future science, technology, or alternate worlds.

examples.sentence: 很多人小时候先是觉得科幻只是想象，长大以后再看，才发现那些故事其实一直在问人和技术应该怎么相处。
她写的不是单纯吓人的故事，而是把家庭、记忆和未来放在一起，所以这本科幻小说读完以后让人想了很久。
电影刚出来的时候，有些观众先是去看画面，后来真正让人记得很久的，反而是那种很安静的科幻感觉。

example_translations.translation: Many people first think in childhood that science fiction is only imagination. Only when they look again after growing up do they realize that those stories have really been asking how people and technology should live together.
What she wrote was not a simple scary story. Instead, she put family, memory, and the future together, so after finishing this science-fiction novel, people kept thinking for a long time.
When the film first came out, some viewers initially went to look at the visuals, but what later truly stayed in people’s minds for a long time was actually that very quiet science-fiction feeling.

glosses.notes: A school subject or tested subject, often used for classes, exams, or training categories.

examples.sentence: 这次考试一共要准备四个科目，如果你总把最难的部分拖到最后，复习计划看起来再完整也很容易乱。
学校调整课程以后，把几个内容差不多的科目放在同一天上，结果学生虽然少跑了几次，却觉得一天更累了。
她不是每个科目都最强，但是她知道自己哪一门需要多花时间，所以成绩一直都不错。

example_translations.translation: There are four subjects to prepare for in this exam. If you always push the hardest part to the end, even a review plan that looks complete can easily fall apart.

After the school adjusted the schedule, it put several subjects with fairly similar content on the same day. As a result, although students had to run around fewer times, they felt the whole day was even more tiring.
She is not strongest in every subject, but she knows which one needs more of her time, so her grades have always been pretty good.

glosses.notes: Used for explaining science to the general public in an accessible, non-specialist way.

examples.sentence: 好的科普不是把很难的词都堆出来，而是让没有背景的人也能一步一步听懂，这其实比单纯讲快更不容易。
他做科普节目很多年了，最在意的不是数据有多漂亮，而是观众听完以后有没有真的愿意继续去了解。
这本书把复杂的问题写得很清楚，所以很多原来一看到图表就头大的读者，也愿意拿它当入门科普来看。

example_translations.translation: Good science popularization is not about piling up difficult terms. It is about letting people without a background in the subject understand step by step, which is actually harder than simply speaking quickly.
He has made science-popularization programs for many years. What he cares about most is not how attractive the numbers look, but whether the audience truly wants to keep learning after listening.
This book explains complicated problems very clearly, so many readers who used to get a headache as soon as they saw charts are also willing to use it as introductory science popularization.

glosses.notes: In this dataset the form is written as 可又; it describes food or drink that tastes pleasantly good.

examples.sentence: 这家小店地方不大，但是面做得真可又，所以一下雨，门口还是有人愿意站着等，老板自己都觉得有点不好意思。
妈妈怕我在外面吃不好，后来听说公司楼下那家食堂又便宜又可又，才总算放心一点。
大家本来只是想随便吃一点，结果那盘菜一上来，不但看着舒服，吃起来也很可又，所以最后什么都差不多吃完了。

example_translations.translation: This little shop is not large, but the noodles are truly delicious, so even when it rains, people are still willing to stand outside and wait, and the owner himself feels a little embarrassed about that.
Mom was afraid that I was not eating well outside, but later, after hearing that the cafeteria downstairs from the company was both cheap and tasty, she finally felt somewhat relieved.
Everyone had originally planned to eat just a little casually, but once that dish arrived, it not only looked nice but also tasted delicious, so in the end almost everything was basically finished.

glosses.notes: Can describe someone as pitiable, or mean to feel pity for someone.

examples.sentence: 他小时候家里条件不好，这当然让人觉得可怜，但是他最不愿意听到的，就是别人只用同情来看他后来的努力。
那只猫站在雨里一直不走，看上去很可怜，但是我们还是先去找旁边的人问清楚，免得把别人家的猫随便抱走。
她说自己不可怜，因为最难的时候已经过去了，现在真正需要的不是一直难过，而是把眼前能做的事做好。

example_translations.translation: His family conditions were poor when he was young, and that certainly makes people feel pity, but what he most dislikes hearing is others using sympathy alone to look at the effort he made later.
That cat kept standing in the rain without leaving and looked pitiful, but we still first went to ask the people nearby clearly so that we would not casually carry off someone else’s cat.
She said she was not to be pitied, because the hardest time had already passed, and what she truly needed now was not to stay sad, but to do well the things she could do right in front of her.

glosses.notes: A strong, deep desire for something such as understanding, love, success, or stability.

examples.sentence: 很多人离开家以后才知道，自己真正渴望的未必是更大的房子，而是一种无论多晚回去都有人等你的安心。
他表面上什么都不说，其实一直很渴望得到父亲的肯定，所以每次听到一点认可，都会记很久。
那时候我们最渴望的不是马上成功，而是先有一个稳定的机会，让已经准备很久的东西终于能被别人认真看见。

example_translations.translation: Only after many people leave home do they realize that what they truly long for may not be a bigger house, but rather the peace of mind of having someone waiting for them no matter how late they return.
On the surface he says nothing, but he has actually always longed for his father’s approval, so every time he hears even a little recognition, he remembers it for a long time.
At that time what we most thirsted for was not instant success, but first having a stable chance so that what we had prepared for such a long time could finally be seriously seen by others.

glosses.notes: Describes a plan or method that can realistically be carried out.

examples.sentence: 这个办法听上去很大胆，但大家讨论了一晚上以后发现，只要时间和人手安排得更细一点，其实还是可行的。
领导没有马上点头，因为一个计划是不是可行，不能只看开始的时候多热闹，还得看后面能不能长期坚持。
她把最坏的情况也算进去以后，才说这个方案基本可行，所以别人虽然着急，还是愿意先按她的节奏来。

example_translations.translation: This method sounds bold, but after everyone discussed it for a whole evening, they found that as long as time and staffing were arranged more carefully, it was still feasible.
The leader did not nod immediately, because whether a plan is workable cannot be judged only by how lively the beginning is; you also have to see whether it can be sustained over the long term.
Only after she had counted even the worst-case situation did she say that this plan was basically feasible, so although the others were anxious, they were still willing to follow her pace first.

glosses.notes: A vehicle for carrying passengers, especially a bus or coach rather than a private car.

examples.sentence: 因为前面的路一度封了，那辆客车在服务区停了很久，车上的人先是着急，后来反而慢慢说起话来。
他年轻时常坐夜里的客车去外地找工作，所以现在一听见夜里客车的发动机响起来，心里还是会想起那几年。
站里通知说这班客车要晚到四十分钟，大家虽然有点失望，却也明白这种天气能平安到就已经很不容易。

example_translations.translation: Because the road ahead had been closed for a while, that passenger bus stayed in the service area for a long time. The people on board were anxious at first, but later they gradually started talking instead.
When he was young, he often took night coaches to other places to look for work, so now whenever he hears the engine of a night passenger bus start up, he still thinks of those years.

The station announced that this bus would arrive forty minutes late. Although everyone felt a little disappointed, they also understood that in weather like this, arriving safely was already not easy.

glosses.notes: Often used for a research topic, project topic, or issue chosen for deeper study.

examples.sentence: 这个课题最难的地方，不是大家不知道要做什么，而是每个人都知道问题重要，却很难抽出完整的时间慢慢做。
她读研究生的时候换过一次课题，因为原来的方向越做越窄，最后连她自己都快忘了最初为什么想研究它。
会上有人提出新的课题以后，大家一下都不说话了，因为如果真做下去，前面的安排要改很多。

example_translations.translation: The hardest part of this topic is not that people do not know what to do, but that everyone knows the issue matters and yet it is difficult to set aside whole stretches of time to work on it slowly.

She changed her research topic once during graduate school, because the original direction kept becoming narrower and narrower, and in the end even she herself was close to forgetting why she had first wanted to study it.
After someone proposed a new topic at the meeting, everyone suddenly fell silent, because if they truly followed it through, a great deal of the earlier arrangement would have to change.

glosses.notes: Expresses willingness to do something, often after hesitation or refusal.

examples.sentence: 我原来以为他一定不会来，没想到打完电话以后，他不但肯帮忙，还主动把最麻烦的部分接了过去。
孩子有时候不是不懂道理，只是情绪上来以后一下拉不回来，这时候你越逼，他越不肯开口。
她后来肯公开谈那段失败的经历，不是因为已经完全不难过了，而是希望别人少走一点自己走过的弯路。

example_translations.translation: I had originally thought he would definitely not come, but after the phone call, not only was he willing to help, he even took on the most troublesome part himself.
Sometimes children do understand the reasoning, but once their emotions rise, they cannot pull themselves back at once. At such times, the more you force them, the less willing they are to speak.

She later became willing to speak publicly about that failed experience, not because it had stopped hurting completely, but because she hoped others would take fewer of the same detours she had taken.

glosses.notes: Describes strong fear, or the feeling of fear itself in a serious context.

examples.sentence: 真正让人产生恐惧的，往往不是眼前已经发生的事，而是你不知道后面还会不会有更坏的结果。
他小时候对黑一直有恐惧，所以长大以后虽然知道没有什么问题，晚上一个人走那条路还是会先紧张。
医生先解释清楚病情，再谈下一步怎么做，因为很多人的恐惧并不是来自痛苦本身，而是来自完全不知道。

example_translations.translation: What truly creates fear in people is often not what has already happened in front of them, but not knowing whether even worse results may still come afterward.
He had always felt fear of the dark when he was a child, so even after growing up, although he knows there is no real problem, he still gets tense first when walking that road alone at night.
The doctor first explained the condition clearly and only then discussed what to do next, because many people’s fear does not come from the pain itself, but from not knowing anything at all.

glosses.notes: An unused or open area of land, often within a neighborhood, site, or yard.

examples.sentence: 老房子后面那块空地原来一直没人管，后来几个住在这里的人商量以后，慢慢把它收拾成了孩子也能活动的地方。
下过雨以后，那片空地看上去更安静了，只有一只球还留在角落里，让人一眼就想到刚才有孩子在这里跑。
他们决定先把空地上收拾出一个能放东西的地方，不是因为条件已经很好，而是冬天快到了，很多东西不能再放在外面。

example_translations.translation: That open space behind the old house had originally been left unmanaged, but after several people living here discussed it, they gradually cleaned it up into a place where children could also move around and be active.
After the rain, that vacant lot looked even quieter. Only a single ball was still left in the corner, making people think at once that children had just been running here.

They decided first to clear out a place on the open ground where things could be stored, not because the conditions were already very good, but because winter was coming and many things could no longer be left outside.

glosses.notes: Describes being free from duties, or refers to free time itself.

examples.sentence: 她最近看上去总在忙，其实真正空闲下来的时候，最想做的不是出门，而是把很久没回的消息一条条看完。
如果你周末有一点空闲，我们可以把上次没谈完的计划重新过一遍，这样下周开始的时候心里会更清楚。
父亲退休以后突然多了不少空闲，开始几天还觉得轻松，后来反而不知道早上起来第一件事该做什么。

example_translations.translation: She has looked busy all the time recently, but when she is truly free, what she most wants to do is not go out, but read through one by one the messages she has not replied to for a long time.
If you have a little free time this weekend, we can go through the plan we did not finish discussing last time, and then when next week begins, things will feel clearer in our minds.

After my father retired, he suddenly had much more leisure. For the first few days he felt relaxed, but later he instead did not know what the first thing he should do after getting up in the morning was.

glosses.notes: In this dataset the form is written as 又感; it refers to the mouthfeel or texture of food when eating it.

examples.sentence: 这种面包刚吃的时候很软，放一会儿再吃又是另一种感觉，所以很多人第一次来就记住了它特别的又感。
她做菜很少靠重味道去压，反而更在意菜本身的又感，因为同样的材料，火一大一小，吃起来差别就很明显。
大家讨论这家店的时候，不只说它甜不甜，还会专门提到又感够不够自然，因为这正是它和别家不一样的地方。

example_translations.translation: This bread is very soft when first eaten, and if you leave it for a while and eat it again, it becomes another kind of feeling, so many people remember its distinctive texture the first time they come.

When she cooks, she rarely relies on heavy flavor to cover things up. Instead, she cares more about the food’s own mouthfeel, because with the same ingredients, a stronger or weaker fire makes an obvious difference when you eat it.

When people discuss this shop, they do not only talk about whether it is sweet or not; they also specifically mention whether the texture feels natural enough, because that is exactly what makes it different from other places.

glosses.notes: In this dataset the form is written as 又号; it refers to a slogan or a short rallying phrase.

examples.sentence: 经理说，一个团队如果天天把又号挂在嘴上，却没有人肯把具体的难事做完，那么再响亮也很难服人。
学校换了新的又号以后，老师先没有急着要求大家背下来，而是花时间说明这句话到底希望大家做到什么。
大家对那个又号印象很深，不是因为字特别难，而是因为它正好说中了很多人一直想说却没说出来的话。

example_translations.translation: The manager said that if a team repeats slogans every day but no one is willing to finish the concrete hard work, then no matter how loud the words are, they will still be hard to make others respect.
After the school changed to a new slogan, the teachers did not rush to demand that everyone memorize it. Instead, they spent time explaining what this phrase was actually asking people to do.
People remembered that slogan very clearly, not because the characters were especially difficult, but because it happened to express what many people had long wanted to say but had not said out loud.

glosses.notes: In this dataset the form is written as 又腔; it refers to the inside of the mouth in medical or pronunciation contexts.

examples.sentence: 医生检查以后说，她的又腔里有一点小问题，现在先不用太怕，但是这段时间说话和吃东西都要更小心。
孩子把小东西放进又腔里的时候，大人最怕的不是他马上哭，而是他什么都不说，只是突然开始咳。
老师讲发音的时候，总提醒我们注意舌头和又腔的位置，因为很多声音听着像，问题其实出在里面的动作不同。

example_translations.translation: After the examination, the doctor said there was a small issue inside her oral cavity. There is no need to be too afraid for now, but during this period she needs to be more careful both when speaking and when eating.
When a child puts a small object into the mouth cavity, what adults fear most is not that the child will cry right away, but that the child will say nothing and suddenly begin to cough.

When the teacher explains pronunciation, he always reminds us to pay attention to the positions of the tongue and the oral cavity, because many sounds seem similar, while the real problem lies in the different movements inside.

glosses.notes: In this dataset the form is written as 又头; it usually means spoken rather than written, and can also suggest something that is only verbal.

examples.sentence: 这件事他只是又头答应了几次，真正要写进计划的时候却一直往后放，所以大家越来越不放心。
老师说，光在又头上说自己明白了还不够，能不能真的做出来，往往要看你回去以后愿不愿意再练。
双方原来只是又头约好见面时间，后来为了少出问题，还是把地点和要求都重新发消息确认了一遍。

example_translations.translation: In this matter he only agreed verbally several times, but when it came time to write it into the plan, he kept pushing it back, so everyone grew more and more uneasy.
The teacher said that it is not enough just to say orally that you understand. Whether you can really do it usually depends on whether you are willing to practice again after you go back.
At first the two sides had only arranged the meeting time verbally, but later, to reduce problems, they still sent another message to confirm both the location and the requirements.

glosses.notes: Can mean to deduct money, fasten with a button, or refer to the button itself.

examples.sentence: 商店说明天开始所有冬天的衣服都打折，但是如果已经参加别的活动，结账的时候就不能再另外扣了。
他发现工资里被多扣了一笔以后，没有马上发火，而是先去问清楚是不是系统更新时出了问题。
母亲一边说我出门总是太急，一边帮我把外套最上面的扣重新扣好，免得风一大就又着凉。

example_translations.translation: The store said that starting tomorrow all winter clothes will be on sale, but if they are already included in another promotion, then an extra deduction cannot be applied again at checkout.
After he discovered that an extra amount had been deducted from his wages, he did not get angry right away, but first went to ask clearly whether a problem had come up during the system update.
While my mother said that I was always in too much of a hurry when going out, she also helped me fasten the top button of my coat again so that I would not catch cold once the wind grew strong.

glosses.notes: Describes something as dry, dull, or lacking interest, especially content, work, or training.

examples.sentence: 很多人以为整理资料很枯燥，但是做久了以后你会发现，那些最小的变化常常就是答案开始出现的地方。
他讲课的内容本来不算轻松，但是因为总能把抽象的问题放回日常里，所以学生并不觉得枯燥。
如果一个人只把训练当成重复命令，那过程当然会显得枯燥，但是一旦看见自己真的进步了，感觉就完全不同。

example_translations.translation: Many people think that organizing materials is boring, but after doing it for a long time, you will find that those very smallest changes are often exactly where the answer begins to appear.
The content of his lectures is not light to begin with, but because he can always bring abstract questions back into daily life, students do not find it dry or boring.
If a person only treats training as repeated orders, then the process will of course seem boring, but once you see that you have truly improved, the feeling becomes completely different.

glosses.notes: An informal, modern adjective meaning cool, impressive, or stylish.

examples.sentence: 年轻人觉得他很酷，不只是因为穿得特别，而是因为别人都在着急证明自己的时候，他反而一直知道自己想做什么。
那张照片现在看还是很酷，因为里面的人没有故意站成什么样子，只是站在风里笑，所以看上去特别自然。
她原来怕父亲不会同意自己的新工作，没想到父亲听完以后只说了一句，很酷，你就认真去做吧。

example_translations.translation: Young people think he is cool not only because he dresses in a distinctive way, but because when everyone else is anxiously trying to prove themselves, he instead has always known what he wants to do.
That photo still looks very cool now, because the person in it was not deliberately standing in any special pose, but was simply standing in the wind and smiling, so it looks especially natural.
She had originally feared that her father would not agree with her new job, but to her surprise, after listening he said only one sentence: very cool, just go do it seriously.

glosses.notes: Can mean to praise someone, or in some contexts to boast or speak in an overly proud way.

examples.sentence: 孩子把画拿来给大家看的时候，母亲先没有急着夸他，而是认真问他为什么要把天空画成那样的颜色。
他这个人最怕别人当面夸自己，所以每次一听到有人开始说，他不是低头笑，就是马上把话题转开。
我们后来决定少夸结果、多夸过程，因为有些人表面上很轻松，其实背后已经反复改了很多次。

example_translations.translation: When the child brought the painting over for everyone to see, his mother did not rush to praise him, but instead seriously asked why he wanted to paint the sky that color.
He is the kind of person who most fears others praising him to his face, so every time he hears someone begin, he either lowers his head and laughs or immediately turns the topic away.
Later we decided to praise results less and praise process more, because some people look relaxed on the surface, but behind the scenes they have actually revised things many times.
